drhp.business:
Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited (MAXENGS) is a precision engineering company based in Vadodara, Gujarat, that manufactures and services critical wear components for underwater pelletizing systems used in polymer compounding, masterbatch, engineering plastics, cable compound and plastics recycling industries. The company was incorporated in 2022 and operates under three segments.

Manufacturing (62.84% of FY2026 revenue) is the core segment, producing pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades/knives, blade holders/cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes and other spare components. Pelletizing die plates contributed ₹1,633.82 lakh (55.48%) of FY2026 revenue and blades/knives ₹594.01 lakh (20.17%). The company also performs customised manufacturing and white-label production. The manufacturing facility at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara commenced operations in July 2025; the earlier facility at Makarpura GIDC has been progressively transitioned out.

Services (19.05% of FY2026 revenue) includes refurbishment and repair of used die plates — a cost-saving proposition for customers — as well as management consulting and intermediary support for CJTEK components. Refurbishing & Repair Services contributed ₹515.59 lakh in FY2026.

Trading (18.11% of FY2026 revenue) covers supply of complementary components (blades/knives, driving bushes, blade holders) to meet demand exceeding in-house manufacturing capacity. The company expects trading to decline as the Waghodia facility scales up.

Revenue from operations was ₹2,944.83 lakh in FY2026, ₹2,209.98 lakh in FY2025 and ₹1,054.33 lakh in FY2024. Export accounted for 84.73% of FY2026 revenue; top export markets were Germany (23.12%), USA (14.80%), Netherlands (14.13%), Austria (9.90%) and Israel (8.38%). Domestic revenue (15.27%) is spread across Gujarat, Telangana, Haryana and other states. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and holds ZED Bronze certification under MSME Sustainable Certification Scheme.
drhp.one_liner: Maxwell Engineering Solutions manufactures die plates, blades and blade holders for underwater pelletizing systems, serving polymer compounders globally from Vadodara.

risks: We are primarily dependent upon few key suppliers for procurement of raw materials & other items.
Any disruption in the supply of the raw materials & other items could have a material adverse effect on our business operations.

Further, any failure by our suppliers to provide raw materials & other items to us on time or at all, or as per our specifications and quality standards could have an adverse impact on our ability to meet our manufacturing and delivery schedules.

Our manufacturing and trading operations are dependent on the timely procurement of critical raw materials, including steel, carbide and brazing filler, as well as certain traded components, from a limited number of suppliers.

The continuity of our manufacturing and trading operations depends upon the ability of these suppliers to provide materials and components that meet our quality standards, commercial requirements and delivery schedules.

Any disruption in the supply of such raw materials or traded components, or any inability to procure them in a timely manner or on commercially acceptable terms, could adversely affect our manufacturing schedules, trading operations and ability to fulfil customer orders.

overview.business_model:
Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited (MAXENGS) is a precision engineering company based in Vadodara, Gujarat, that manufactures and services critical wear components for underwater pelletizing systems used in polymer compounding, masterbatch, engineering plastics, cable compound and plastics recycling industries. The company was incorporated in 2022 and operates under three segments.

Manufacturing (62.84% of FY2026 revenue) is the core segment, producing pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades/knives, blade holders/cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes and other spare components. Pelletizing die plates contributed ₹1,633.82 lakh (55.48%) of FY2026 revenue and blades/knives ₹594.01 lakh (20.17%). The company also performs customised manufacturing and white-label production. The manufacturing facility at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara commenced operations in July 2025; the earlier facility at Makarpura GIDC has been progressively transitioned out.

Services (19.05% of FY2026 revenue) includes refurbishment and repair of used die plates — a cost-saving proposition for customers — as well as management consulting and intermediary support for CJTEK components. Refurbishing & Repair Services contributed ₹515.59 lakh in FY2026.

Trading (18.11% of FY2026 revenue) covers supply of complementary components (blades/knives, driving bushes, blade holders) to meet demand exceeding in-house manufacturing capacity. The company expects trading to decline as the Waghodia facility scales up.

Revenue from operations was ₹2,944.83 lakh in FY2026, ₹2,209.98 lakh in FY2025 and ₹1,054.33 lakh in FY2024. Export accounted for 84.73% of FY2026 revenue; top export markets were Germany (23.12%), USA (14.80%), Netherlands (14.13%), Austria (9.90%) and Israel (8.38%). Domestic revenue (15.27%) is spread across Gujarat, Telangana, Haryana and other states. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and holds ZED Bronze certification under MSME Sustainable Certification Scheme.
overview.business_overview:
Our Company was originally incorporated on September 13, 2022 as “Maxwell Engineering Solutions Private Limited” vide Registration No. 135432 under the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 with the Registrar of Companies, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Subsequently, the Company was converted into a Public Limited Company pursuant to a Special Resolution passed at the Extra- Ordinary General Meeting held on June 09, 2025. As a result, the name of the Company was changed from “Maxwell Engineering Solutions Private Limited” to “Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited”. A fresh Certificate of Incorporation reflecting the change was issued by the Registrar of Companies, Central Processing Centre on June 30, 2025. For details of change in name and registered office of our Company, please refer to chapter titled “History and Corporate Structure” beginning on page no. 201 of this Draft Red Herring Prospectus.

Our Company is a precision engineering company engaged in the business of manufacturing, trading and servicing of critical components for underwater pelletizing systems. Our company manufactures pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades/knives, blade holders/cutter hub, tapped driving bush for underwater pelletizing systems and other spare items. To support our future growth and enhance our manufacturing capabilities, we commenced operations at our company-owned manufacturing facility situated at Plot Nos. 939 & 940, Waghodia GIDC, Vaghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat with effect from July 01, 2025 and have gradually transitioned manufacturing operations from our earlier leased facility situated at Shed No. 336/34/1-A, GIDC, Makarpura, Vadodara-390010, Gujarat, India. This expansion is expected to strengthen our production capabilities, improve operational efficiencies and progressively reduce our dependence on trading activities. We also undertake customized manufacturing based on customer specifications and offer our products on a white-label basis, enabling customers to market such products under their own brands while leveraging our manufacturing expertise. Our Company has entered into agreements with selected job workers to carry out specific processes related to its manufacturing operations. Under these arrangements, our Company supplies the required raw materials, while the job workers undertake operations such as machining, fabrication, welding, painting and other ancillary activities. We also outsource works requiring heat treatment, hardening, coating wherever required as we don't have the in-house facilities and to keep our manufacturing process clean, non-polluting with zero emissions.

We also offer services, including refurbishing & repair services, intermediary support & management consulting. Our refurbishment services for used die plates help customers significantly reduce costs while improving product efficiency. Additionally, we act as an intermediary between CJTEK and third parties for the marketing and supply of CJTEK components. We also provide management consulting services for identifying and developing new customer relationships. We also represent CJTEK in exhibitions and market its product.

We also undertake selective trading of complementary components such as blades/knives, driving bushes, blade holders and related items to meet customer requirements and provide comprehensive solutions Our manufacturing facility is equipped with modern precision machining equipment and in-house testing facilities to support the manufacture of high-quality precision-engineered components. Our products cater to applications across polymer compounding, masterbatches, engineering plastics, cable compounds, specialty polymers and plastics recycling industries.

Our Manufacturing facility are equipped with requisite machineries like VMC, CNC, Furnace Machine, Milling Machine, Wire cuts Machine, EDM Machine, Lathe Machine, Surface grinders Machine and other machines tools to manufacture precision engineering components and in-house testing system to keep a constant check on quality of our product. We have expanded globally, serving the customers spread over the countries like the USA, Germany, Netherland, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Indonesia, Japan, Luxembourg, Vietnam, Italy, Switzerland, Austria, South Africa, Australia, Thailand, etc. Our product includes the die plates for various applications like white, black, filler, additives, color masterbatches, cable compounds like HFFR, semiconductive, PVC, XLPE, HDPE blends, fluoropolymers like PFA, FEP, and PVDF, engineering compounds like BS, PA, PBT,PC, and PE, TPR, TPU, TPV, PET/PA resin productions, post-consumer and post-industrial recycling of ET, PP, PE, PVC, and many more applications.

Our company began its operations in 2022 under the brand name “Maxwell,” founded by our promoters, Mr. Rajkumar Chaudhary and Mr. Vinubhai Kanjibhai Chavda. They have a combined experience of over 22 years in the underwater pelletizing systems industry. Their extensive industry knowledge and strategic leadership contribute significantly to the growth and development of our Company. Additionally, we are supported by an experienced technical, production and sales team.

Our Company is certified with ISO 9001:2015 for manufacturing and Supply of Die Plates/Heads, Pelletizing Blades/Knives, Blade Holders, Tapped Driving Bushes, which reflects our commitment to ensuring that we maintain quality standards across all operations. Further strengthening our commitment to quality and sustainable manufacturing, our Company was awarded the ZED Bronze Certification under the MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme on November 28, 2025.

To manage sales operations across India and international markets, our Company has established a dedicated Sales and Marketing Department responsible for business development, customer relationship management and market expansion. The department is headed by the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), who, together with the Sales Manager and the sales team, is responsible for formulating and implementing the Company's sales and marketing strategies, developing customer relationships, generating business opportunities and expanding our market presence through customer outreach, market research, brand promotion and participation in industry exhibitions.

Further, any failure by our suppliers to provide raw materials & other items to us on time or at all, or as per our specifications and quality standards could have an adverse impact on our ability to meet our manufacturing and delivery schedules.

Our Company has availed benefits under the Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG) Scheme, which provides duty concessions on capital goods imports subject to the fulfilment of specified export obligations within a prescribed time period.
As on the date of this Draft Red Herring Prospectus, our Company is required to fulfil export obligations aggregating to ₹1,309.62 lakhs within the prescribed period of six years.

summary.business:
Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited (MAXENGS) is a precision engineering company based in Vadodara, Gujarat, that manufactures and services critical wear components for underwater pelletizing systems used in polymer compounding, masterbatch, engineering plastics, cable compound and plastics recycling industries. The company was incorporated in 2022 and operates under three segments.

Manufacturing (62.84% of FY2026 revenue) is the core segment, producing pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades/knives, blade holders/cutter hubs, tapped driving bushes and other spare components. Pelletizing die plates contributed ₹1,633.82 lakh (55.48%) of FY2026 revenue and blades/knives ₹594.01 lakh (20.17%). The company also performs customised manufacturing and white-label production. The manufacturing facility at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara commenced operations in July 2025; the earlier facility at Makarpura GIDC has been progressively transitioned out.

Services (19.05% of FY2026 revenue) includes refurbishment and repair of used die plates — a cost-saving proposition for customers — as well as management consulting and intermediary support for CJTEK components. Refurbishing & Repair Services contributed ₹515.59 lakh in FY2026.

Trading (18.11% of FY2026 revenue) covers supply of complementary components (blades/knives, driving bushes, blade holders) to meet demand exceeding in-house manufacturing capacity. The company expects trading to decline as the Waghodia facility scales up.

Revenue from operations was ₹2,944.83 lakh in FY2026, ₹2,209.98 lakh in FY2025 and ₹1,054.33 lakh in FY2024. Export accounted for 84.73% of FY2026 revenue; top export markets were Germany (23.12%), USA (14.80%), Netherlands (14.13%), Austria (9.90%) and Israel (8.38%). Domestic revenue (15.27%) is spread across Gujarat, Telangana, Haryana and other states. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and holds ZED Bronze certification under MSME Sustainable Certification Scheme.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- We are primarily dependent upon few key suppliers for procurement of raw materials & other items.
- Any disruption in the supply of the raw materials & other items could have a material adverse effect on our business operations.
- Further, any failure by our suppliers to provide raw materials & other items to us on time or at all, or as per our specifications and quality standards could have an adverse impact on our ability to meet our manufacturing and delivery schedules.
- Our manufacturing and trading operations are dependent on the timely procurement of critical raw materials, including steel, carbide and brazing filler, as well as certain traded components, from a limited number of suppliers.
- The continuity of our manufacturing and trading operations depends upon the ability of these suppliers to provide materials and components that meet our quality standards, commercial requirements and delivery schedules.
- Any disruption in the supply of such raw materials or traded components, or any inability to procure them in a timely manner or on commercially acceptable terms, could adversely affect our manufacturing schedules, trading operations and ability to fulfil customer orders.
